description: Doc pour FAQ Fibre optique is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SFR, Orange, Covage et DIr. Aménagement Numérique de la CA Grand Paris Sud. Liste des documents à télécharger accompagnant la FAQ de l'Observatoire numérique. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Télecommunications. Its keywords are convention, SFR, Covage, orange, FAQ. The portal shows 8 records. The portal shows 2020-11-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
